info.text:
C.H. Robinson owns very few trucks, yet after paying truckers its North American unit kept $1.71B of the $11.56B shippers paid it in 2025 (before its own staff and tech costs).

The model: shippers pay the broker, the broker hires a trucking company for less, and keeps the spread. In 2025 that averaged 14.8% (hypothetical $1,000 load: $852 to the trucker, $148 kept).
The spread swings: 12.4% in 2021, 14.8% in 2025, and 13.1% in Q2 2026 after truckload costs per mile jumped 29%.
In August 2026, DAT's van spot rate was $2.19 a mile vs $2.41 on contract.

Sources: C.H. Robinson 10-K filings (FY2021-FY2025), Q2 2026 results; DAT (Sept 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
